purpose: TOT-5 follow-up: measure ORI's coverage of the provider corpus PER ERA, not only in the recent window. The prior 401/401 figure measured text presence among items ORI carries, which is not a coverage measurement at all.
method: Provider side = the 785 documents already in battery_sample.json (era-stratified, harvested during the 2026-07-25 re-onboard). Aggregator side = a full paged walk of ORI's MediaObjects requesting only original_url + last_discussed_at, reduced to a set of provider document ids. Coverage is a local set operation. ZERO requests to api.notubiz.nl.

provider_sample.content_check: The uncovered eras are NOT empty placeholders: era 2008 = 23 PDFs + 5 msword (median 23 KB, max 1.77 MB, e.g. 'Kadernota Parkeerbeleid' 648 KB); era 2012 = 58 PDFs (median 407 KB, max 13.1 MB). ORI carries none of them.

pre_2014_volume_estimate.method_a: events/yr from battery_sample.era_event_counts (2008: 65, 2012: 58) x ~6 years (2008-2013) x era docs/meeting from the same sample (2008: 5.6, 2012: 11.6) => ~2,000-4,200
pre_2014_volume_estimate.method_b: corpus residual: ORI holds 16,778 distinct provider doc ids for 2013+; the manifest's own full-backfill estimate is ~19,000 documents => ~2,200-3,000 outside ORI's range
pre_2014_volume_estimate.confidence: low-medium — two independent routes agree on the order of magnitude, but docs/meeting is sampled from 5 meetings per era and grows sharply over time (2008: 5.6 -> 2021: 74.2), so this is an order estimate, not a count
pre_2014_volume_estimate.why_it_matters: it is the size of the api.notubiz.nl backfill the ORI route CANNOT remove, i.e. the residual POL-1 exposure for this source

vlaardingen.shape: sparse head — 133 items in 2010, ZERO in 2011-2012, 606 in 2013, ~1,000-1,650/yr from 2014

haarlem.note: manifests/haarlem_raad.yaml already records DRIFT-2: 2008/2012 meetings carry 0 documents, documents only ~2013+. So ORI's 2014 start costs Haarlem little or nothing — the SAME aggregator has a materially different coverage cost per municipality, which is why archive depth must be probed per source, not read off the registry.

corrects: The '401/401 carrying page text over 2010-2013' figure recorded against TOT-5 as archival reassurance measured TEXT PRESENCE AMONG ITEMS ORI CARRIES. It never compared against the provider, so it was not a coverage measurement and cannot support 'the deficit is recent-window, not archival'. This probe is the coverage measurement, and it says the opposite: the deficit has TWO ends.
reading: ORI's coverage of Vlaardingen is excellent in the middle and absent at both ends. 2014-2026: 95.6-100% (393/396 sampled; scattered single misses in 2016/2018/2021). 2008-2013: 0% (0/86 sampled) — a hard archival cutoff, ~2,000-3,000 real documents. Recent window: lagging (TOT-5, 28 of 30 absentees inside the covered window). CONSEQUENCE for aggregator-registry.md §8 step 4: the honest split is THREE roles, not two — provider for the pre-2014 backfill, ORI for 2014-2025, provider for the recent window/incremental. The ORI route removes ~85% of api.notubiz.nl traffic, not 100%, so it SHRINKS the POL-1 question for this host rather than dissolving it. Note also that an ORI-only route cannot even DISCOVER pre-2014 items, so the project's scoping rule ('discover all, process scoped, defer the rest as metadata stubs') cannot be honoured on that route without touching the provider.
